mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,paper_no,blueprint_id,blueprint_version_snapshot,fixed_paper_id,fixed_paper_code,fixed_paper_version,status,started_at,due_at,submitted_at,objective_score,translation_self_score,writing_self_score,self_score_total,version,created_at,updated_at FROM exam_paper WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY started_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,version FROM exam_blueprint WHERE blueprint_code=#{code} AND status='ENABLED' AND duration_minutes=120 AND total_score=100 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: s.enabled=1 AND s.review_status='APPROVED' AND s.copyright_status IN ('ORIGINAL','AUTHORIZED','PUBLIC_OFFICIAL')

SELECT g.id,COUNT(q.id) AS member_count FROM exam_question_group g JOIN exam_question_source s ON s.id=g.source_id JOIN exam_question q ON q.group_id=g.id WHERE g.enabled=1 AND g.review_status='APPROVED' AND GROUP BY g.id,g.group_type,g.source_id HAVING SUM(q.review_status!='APPROVED' OR q.enabled!=1 OR q.source_id!=g.source_id OR (g.group_type='DIALOGUE' AND q.question_type!='DIALOGUE_BLANK') OR (g.group_type='READING' AND q.question_type!='READING'))=0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT q.group_sort_order)=COUNT(q.id) AND MIN(q.group_sort_order)>=1 AND ((g.group_type='DIALOGUE' AND COUNT(q.id) BETWEEN 1 AND 8) OR (g.group_type='READING' AND COUNT(q.id)=5))
mapper.select: SELECT g.id,g.group_type,g.title,g.instruction,g.content,g.shared_options,g.source_id,g.difficulty, g.knowledge_points,g.content_fingerprint,g.review_status,g.enabled,g.created_at,g.updated_at,e.member_count FROM exam_question_group g JOIN () e ON e.id=g.id ORDER BY g.id

SELECT q.id,q.group_id,q.question_type,q.stem,q.options,q.correct_answer,q.explanation,q.reference_answer,q.sample_answer, q.scoring_rubric,q.source_id,q.group_sort_order,q.difficulty,q.knowledge_points,q.content_fingerprint, q.review_status,q.enabled,q.created_at,q.updated_at FROM exam_question q JOIN exam_question_source s ON s.id=q.source_id WHERE q.enabled=1 AND q.review_status='APPROVED' AND AND ((q.group_id IS NULL AND q.question_type IN ('VOCABULARY','GRAMMAR','TRANSLATION','WRITING')) OR q.group_id IN (SELECT eligible.id FROM () eligible)) ORDER BY q.id
SELECT DISTINCT i.original_question_id FROM exam_paper_item_snapshot i JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id=i.paper_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT g.original_group_id FROM exam_paper_group_snapshot g JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id=g.paper_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId}

SELECT id,paper_id,original_group_id,section_order,group_order,title,instruction,content,shared_options,created_at FROM exam_paper_group_snapshot WHERE paper_id=#{paperId} ORDER BY section_order,group_order,id

SELECT id,paper_id,paper_group_snapshot_id,original_question_id,section_order,item_order,question_type,stem,options,correct_answer,explanation,reference_answer,sample_answer,scoring_rubric,knowledge_points,score,created_at FROM exam_paper_item_snapshot WHERE paper_id=#{paperId} ORDER BY section_order,item_order,id
